text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills stood at 57.25 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 12, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Monday.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 5.711 million UAH 10.678 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.998 million UAH 9.344 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 57,111 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is unfixed.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills stood at 59.50 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 12, a central bank statement said.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 21,098 UAH 19.567 million UAH
The central bank sold 274 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
